title: Structured contribution and review-to-archive map-close evidence
closure_rule: Every required category must have covered scenarios and at least one automated gate command or immutable artifact location before #174 can close.

categories.required_by_issue_193: Draft, validation, formal Submit, immutable revisions, duplicate, request-information, not-accepted, accepted, withdrawal, and target-change scenarios.

scenarios.acceptance: Contributor draft, validation, submit, immutable revision, duplicate, reviewer outcome, withdrawal, and target-change states remain explicit and do not create Archive publication facts.
gate_commands: uv run --directory services/api --frozen --extra dev pytest -q tests/community_intake tests/integration/test_contributor_journey_real_db.py

categories.required_by_issue_193: Private upload limits, quarantine, malware, failed scan, signed access, EXIF stripping, access audit, rights boundary, retention, deletion, and recovery.

scenarios.acceptance: Attachment storage remains private, bounded, auditable, recoverable, and separate from public Archive state until release projection.

categories.required_by_issue_193: Reviewer capability, self-review denial, assignment concurrency, SLA, source normalization, internal-note privacy, and append-only decision tests.

scenarios.acceptance: ReviewCase assignment, capability, self-review denial, SLA queues, normalized evidence, note privacy, and append-only decisions are verified before bridge creation.
gate_commands: uv run --directory services/api --frozen --extra dev pytest -q tests/review_moderation tests/contracts/test_review_case_storage_contract.py

categories.required_by_issue_193: Full and partial Change Set provenance, self-publication denial, Release pending state, Public Projection-driven incorporation, correction/retraction, and broken-chain alerting.

scenarios.acceptance: Accepted assertions bridge to Curation Change Sets without becoming Archive approval; Release observation and Public Projection are the incorporation boundary.

categories.required_by_issue_193: Notification and email behavior using #173 without duplicate Submit or incorporation messages.

scenarios.acceptance: Submit and incorporation notification intents are idempotent, Inbox-visible, and email delivery remains behind #173 transport and rollback policy.

categories.required_by_issue_193: Browser/mobile/WCAG, API contract, privacy, security, performance, database/attachment restore, feature-flag rollback, and immutable Release Gate evidence.

scenarios.acceptance: Contributor, reviewer, admin, feed, and inbox browser paths remain keyboard-accessible, mobile-safe, and covered by the map-close gate.

categories.required_by_issue_193: Database/attachment restore, feature-flag rollback, staging evidence, immutable hashes, and rollback/recovery drills.

scenarios.acceptance: Recovery drills, rollback switches, staging evidence, and immutable release-gate manifests are recorded before #174 closes.
